summary: Post-refactor regression pass (ProcedureExplorer split, upload _save_upload/_check_ext, admin _decode_session, consultation email safety, translate _translate_content). 4 new backend test files + 2 new browser checks added for previously-uncovered criteria; 4 existing browser checks re-ran clean. All 15 backend tests pass (12 pre-existing + regressions, 3 new files added this iteration added 7 new test functions total across admin-session/upload-rollback/translate). 6 browser checks passed total this iteration (4 regression re-runs + 2 new). No bugs found.

checks.criterion: Procedure Explorer still works after refactor (ProcedureList, ExplorerInfoPanel, useHindiContent split)
checks.name: explorer-full-controls
checks.evidence: Re-ran persisted check on /explorer: 47 select buttons rendered, selecting evar updates explorer-procedure-title, steps 1/3 change explorer-step-caption, zoom/rotate/labels/reset/compare toggles, doctor/patient mode tabs all work. No errors.

checks.criterion: Switching procedures remounts 3D lesions/devices (sceneId keys) without console/WebGL errors
checks.name: explorer-scene-remount-multi-switch
checks.evidence: New check: switched /explorer through evar -> fevar-concept -> aortoiliac-kissing-stents -> evar, canvas stayed visible after each switch; then on homepage clicked explorer-tab-clti-limb-salvage/evar/iliocaval-reconstruction/dvt-thrombectomy in sequence, canvas remained rendered. console_errors: [].

checks.criterion: Hindi patient mode still works after extracting useHindiContent
checks.name: explorer-hindi-mode
checks.evidence: New check: on /explorer with evar selected, patient mode + explorer-lang-hi shows Devanagari text in explorer-step-caption plus explorer-hindi-note; switching back to explorer-lang-en restores exact original English caption; doctor mode (even with hi selected) shows no Devanagari and hides explorer-hindi-note.

checks.criterion: Hindi translate endpoint refactor (_translate_content) - cached hit, bad slug 404, malformed 422
checks.name: test_tscheck_translate_endpoint.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/translate/evar with evar's exact English PatientContent (verified via matching sha256 cache key in Mongo translations collection) -> 200, cached=true, content.steps length 6. POST /api/translate/BAD_SLUG! -> 404. POST /api/translate/evar with {title:'x'} -> 422.

checks.criterion: Referral upload validation and rollback (_save_upload/_check_ext) - oversize rejection + no residual files
checks.name: test_tscheck_referral_upload_rollback.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/referrals with a small.pdf + a 26MB big.pdf -> 400 'tscheck-big.pdf exceeds 25 MB'; verified /app/backend/uploads directory listing unchanged before/after (both files, including the already-written small one, rolled back). Valid single .pdf -> 201 with reference REF-xxxxxxxx.

checks.name: test_tscheck_referral_form.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/referrals with payload + tscheck-malware.exe -> 400; admin file endpoint requires auth (401/404).

checks.criterion: Admin auth refactor (_decode_session) - missing vs invalid cookie distinction
checks.name: test_tscheck_admin_session_expired.py
checks.evidence: GET /api/admin/consultations with no cookie -> 401 'Not authenticated'; with Cookie: dvir_admin=not-a-valid-jwt-token -> 401 'Session expired'.

checks.criterion: Admin auth refactor - full login/inbox flow via UI (regression)
checks.name: admin-inbox-flow
checks.evidence: Re-ran persisted check: wrong password rejected with 'invalid email or password', correct credentials (admin@delhivascularir.com) log in, consultations tab shows a fixture row, referrals tab shows attachment link pattern /api/admin/files/, status update shows 'status updated', logout returns to login form. The 3 reported console 401s are the deliberate wrong-password/unauthenticated probes, not regressions.

checks.name: consult-form-submission
checks.evidence: Re-ran persisted check on /contact: submit without consent blocked (consult-success stays hidden), checking consent then submitting shows consult-success with reference matching /^CONS-[A-F0-9]{8}$/. Backend log shows no email safety ValueError, only the expected background-task email send log lines.

checks.criterion: Consultation submission regression (homepage flagship explorer tabs still functional)
checks.name: home-explorer-flagship-tabs
checks.evidence: Re-ran persisted check: flagship tabs visible, canvas mounts, title shows CLTI initially, clicking evar/aneurysm-coiling tabs updates explorer-procedure-title correctly.

checks.criterion: Live preview ingress path sanity (ingress contract)
checks.name: live-preview-contact-submission
checks.evidence: Against https://delhi-vascular-ir--7t3oh8d2.preview.emergentagent.com: home, /explorer, and /contact form submission all worked; got reference CONS-2157FF9A. Row deleted from Mongo consultations by its exact id (2157ff9a-...) after the check, confirmed deleted_count=1.
